title: Jolly Old Saint Nicholas
writers: Words from Emily Huntington Miller's 1865 poem 'Lilly's Secret'; music by James R. Murray (published 1874)

evidence.note: Miller's words appeared in 1865 and Murray's tune was published separately in 1874; the standard words-and-music version known today was first published together in the Franklin Square Song Collection No. 1 (1881), edited by John Piersol McCaskey.

famous_use: Ray Conniff's 1962 recording, on the album 'We Wish You a Merry Christmas', helped that album reach platinum status.
